'''Geezum''' was a [[Snivvian]] [[Gender|male]] who in [[4 ABY]] was present in the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] when the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] [[Death|killed]] Jabba's [[rancor]] [[Pateesa]]. While the Snivvian watched, the crime lord sentenced Skywalker and his allies [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]] to death, ordering they be fed to the [[sarlacc]].

Geezum traveled to view the executions on board the [[sail barge]] ''[[Khetanna]]'', conversing with the [[Ugnaught]] [[Yoxgit]] and [[Fozec]]. Upon reaching the pit, Skywalker managed to defeat the guards accompanying him while the [[Slavery|slave]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] plunged Geezum and the other passengers of the barge into darkness by closing its shutters. She then killed Jabba, and together with Skywalker, destroyed the barge.

==Biography==
===Dancing and death===
[[File:Geezum-Oola-ROTJ.png|thumb|right|300px|Geezum (center, top) watched Oola dance at Jabba's Palace.]]
The [[Snivvian]] [[Gender|male]] Geezum<ref name="SWVE" /> was present in the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]<ref name="Absolutely Everything">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> in the [[Standard year|year]] [[4 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> during a performance of the [[Music|song]] "[[Jedi Rocks]]" by the [[Max Rebo Band]]. The Snivvian sat in one of the throne room's booths with the [[bounty hunter]] [[Amanaman]] and the [[accountant]] [[Tessek]] while the band performed for the court, after which Jabba demand it be played again.<ref name="ROTJ" />

The second performance was however interrupted when the [[Slavery|enslaved]] dancer [[Oola]] refused the Hutt's advances, causing the crime lord to drop her into the pit beneath the throne room. Many court members then eagerly watched her be devored by Jabba's pet [[rancor]], [[Pateesa]], after which [[blaster]] fire in the throne room entry way drew their attention. The source was revealed to be [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], who was disguised as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]] and entered with the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] as her [[prisoner]]. After negotiating with Jabba over the [[bounty]] on Chewbacca using a [[thermal detonator]], Organa agreed to a price, but was later captured by Jabba herself after freeing the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] from [[carbonite]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

===Prisoners causing problems===
[[File:Geezum_at_the_sentencing.png|thumb|left|250px|Geezum (center-right) witnessed Jabba sentence Solo, Skywalker and Chewbacca to death.]]
He was later present when the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker]] [[Death|killed]] the criminal's pet [[rancor]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Pateesa]],<ref name="Life Debt">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref> after Jabba tried to feed the [[Jedi]] to the beast. Geezum stood in the palace's throne room as Skywalker was dragged from the rancor's pit before Jabba alongside his [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] allies [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]], who had been being held in the Hutt's dungeons.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Jabba sentenced the three prisoners to death, declaring they would be fed to the [[sarlacc]] that lived in the [[Dune Sea]]. Geezum then accompanied Jabba and much of his court onboard the Hutt's personnel<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[sail barge]] ''[[Khetanna]]''<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> to witness the executions. While the barge traveled, Geezum stood at one of its windows conversing with the<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Ugnaught]] [[Yoxgit]]<ref name="SWVE" /> and the [[human]] guard [[Fozec]]. As the trio conversed, the [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]], who was serving as the Hutt's [[translator]], bumped into the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] in front of them, spilling several of the drinks the astromech had been serving to the barge's passengers.<ref name="ROTJ" />

===Chaos at the Great Pit of Carkoon===
[[File:Geezum_on_the_sail_barge.png|thumb|right|250px|Geezum (left) spoke with Yoxgit and Fozec onboard the ''Khetanna''.]]
Upon reaching the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]] where the sarlacc dwelt, Geezum stood behind Jabba and his [[Slavery|slave]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] while the Hutt offered Skywalker and his allies a final chance to plead for their lives. Before he could be pushed into the pit, the Jedi managed to overpower the guards on the<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Bantha-II cargo skiff]]<ref name="USW" /> he was being transported on using his [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber|lightsaber]], which R2 had been secretly carrying for him. Organa used the distraction to close the barge's shutters, plunging Geezum and the other passengers into darkness.<ref name="ROTJ" />

As the Snivvian dashed around the barge in a panic with the other members of the court, Organa strangled Jabba using her chains. Skywalker then managed to board the ''Khetanna'' and together with Organa destroyed it before escaping with the rest of his allies.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Geezum was a sociopathic Snivvian<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> who had fair skin, [[Color|brown]] [[hair]] and black [[eye]]s.<ref name="SWVE" />

==Equipment==
While on Tatooine, Geezum wore a white [[Clothing|shirt]] and pants with a brown scarf, [[glove]]s and [[boot]]s. He wore a black [[belt]] and an orange [[Bandolier]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Geezum was portrayed by [[Peter Allen]]<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-in-the-uk-memorabilia-23-24-november-2013|text=Star Wars in the UK: Memorabilia, 23-24 November 2013}}</ref> in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The palace throne room scenes were filmed between [[January 25]] and [[February 8]], [[1982]] on Stage 8 at [[Elstree Studios]] and the sail barge interior shots filmed on Stage 9 between [[February 9]] and [[February 11]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="SWVE" /> The name [[Geezum/Legends|Geezum]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where if first appeared on a card in the [[1998]] "[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]" set of cards for the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' released by [[Decipher]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Geezum}}</ref>
